name: Acetoxyketobemidone
summary: Acetoxyketobemidone (O-Acetylketobemidone) is an opioid analgesic that is an acetylated derivative of ketobemidone. It was developed in the 1950s during research into analogues of pethidine and was assessed by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime but was not included on the list of drugs under international control, probably because it was not used in medicine or widely available.

sideEffects.text: Presumably acetoxyketobemidone produces similar effects to ketobemidone and other opioids, such as analgesia and sedation, along with side effects such as nausea, itching, vomiting and respiratory depression which may be harmful or fatal.

pharmacology.en: It is an acetylated form of ketobemidone and acts on the μ-opioid receptor, the main target of opioid painkillers.
pharmacology.zh: 它是ketobemidone的乙醯化形式，作用於μ鴉片受體，也就是鴉片類止痛藥的主要作用目標。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是ketobemidone的乙酰化形式，作用于μ鸦片受体，也就是鸦片类止痛药的主要作用目标。

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been marketed as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未作為藥品上市。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未作为药品上市。

fact.en: It was made in the 1950s during research on pethidine analogues, and the United Nations later assessed it but did not place it under international control.
fact.zh: 它是在1950年代研究配西汀類似物時合成的；聯合國後來對它進行評估，但並未將它納入國際管制。
fact.zhHans: 它是在1950年代研究配西汀类似物时合成的；联合国后来对它进行评估，但并未将它纳入国际管制。
